5634.title: Terminal relay shares the server event loop
5634.rootCauseOneLine: Both terminal WebSocket endpoints and byte forwarding execute on the main server event loop; synchronous unrelated work blocks the relay, and the client waits for remote PTY echo.
5634.proposedFix: Design an independently serviced terminal data plane while retaining lifecycle and policy on the server. Predictive local echo is a separate opt-in product decision, not an automatic bug fix.
5634.caveats: Transport-boundary reproduction uses the real server routes, migrated SQLite, real WebSockets, and node-pty running cat, with a small daemon-protocol fixture rather than the complete daemon. No browser rendering, Connect deployment, or personal server log counts were verified. No automatic fix: transport isolation requires architecture/protocol decisions.
